### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **23** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/core/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**23** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/core/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `created_at (literal, 43 pages)`
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **51** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ea18058ba0432ef0b6d927d0745d84631a3de680` — the merge of head `22a779351bf40b62e478721343b78d8360b53b7d` into base `399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ea18058ba0432ef0b6d927d0745d84631a3de680 && git checkout ea18058ba0432ef0b6d927d0745d84631a3de680
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a 22a779351bf40b62e478721343b78d8360b53b7d && git checkout -B drift-repro 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a && git merge --no-ff 22a779351bf40b62e478721343b78d8360b53b7d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `22a779351bf40b62e478721343b78d8360b53b7d`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #29277 (body and all 8 comments: triage 6575406743, claim 6576911211, dev reports 6577038603 and 6581571774, block 6577287839, seat rulings 6581612131 and 6582252856, claim amendment 6584075217), maintainer ruling B on #29346 (6579813296), the PR body, its 17-file list, and the net diff `origin/main...pr29464` (merge base `0e0ddacd`; `origin/main` is `399df5bb`, and `git merge-tree` merges the two cleanly; the only main-side change to a touched file is #29241's string-arm hunk in `record-validator.ts`, in a different region).

Check-runs on the head: green includes Lint and Repo Gates, Lint (ESLint, PM dispatch-gates, docs and code guards, repo and tooling gates, CI/release/engine gates, the scoped lints), Type Check (debt ledger, source gates), PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check PR Size, Plan Test Core shards. Red: `Check Changeset`, two runs, both only on `check-empty-changeset` (judged in ②). **Still in progress or queued:** Build Core, Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Type Check (workspace, consumer gates, UI), Build and E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test UI 1/16 to 16/16, and a re-queued Lint and Repo Gates. This review does not stand in for any of them.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The three new `@objectstack/core` exports: right, each the one spelling.** `packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.ts` is re-exported from `packages/core/src/index.ts` by `export *`. It adds three runtime exports (`blankAsNullColumns`, `blankStorageForm`, `ENGINE_LIFECYCLE_COLUMNS`) and two types (`BlankAsNullReach`, `BlankAsNullFieldDef`). `ONE_STRING_STORED_TYPES` and `UNIQUE_BLANK_TEXT_TYPES` stay module-private. Core already depends on `@objectstack/spec`, and metadata-protocol already depends on core, so no edge is added. `record-validator.ts` keeps no arm logic of its own. `optionalUniqueTextColumns` and `UNIQUE_BLANK_TEXT_TYPES` are deleted, along with the `NON_TEXT_STORED_VALUE_TYPES`, `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` and `isUniqueDeclared` imports. `normalizeBlankTypedRow` keeps only the `isMissing` pre-filter, which is a fast path both reaches share. It then asks `blankStorageForm(value, reachOf(name))`, with the map built lazily once per call as before. `SKIP_FIELDS` is now `new Set(ENGINE_LIFECYCLE_COLUMNS)`, the same five names.
2. **The accept set is unchanged on the two older arms, and the #29277 arm is added as ruled: right.** Read line by line against `origin/main`:
   - **Typed (#20308).** `NON_TEXT_STORED_VALUE_TYPES` is checked first and maps to `'blank'`, so any `isMissing` string becomes `null`. Required and lifecycle columns are included, as on main, where that arm never read `SKIP_FIELDS`. The core test pins `created_at`.
   - **Unique text (#29176).** It still applies to `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` minus `password`/`secret`, not required, not lifecycle, and covered through `isUniqueDeclared` on the field or a unique `indexes[]` entry. The inline object check matches the spec's `isPlainRecord` byte for byte. The own-property guard for names like `constructor` is kept, now by a `Map` built from `Object.entries`.
   - **#29277.** It reaches exactly `''`, on a column that is not required, not lifecycle, `expandEmptyOperator(def).arm === 'null_only'`, and in `ONE_STRING_STORED_TYPES` (`SINGLE_OPTION_TYPES`, `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES`, `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`). Those are the spec's constants, not re-listed. `expandEmptyOperator` on main sends multi-value to `multi_value`, `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` to `text`, and everything else to `null_only`. So a `multiple: true` column is out (the #29343 row), and the ternary keeps a text type from ever reaching the new arm.
   - **Derivation.** The set is derived from the table's `null_only` row plus one stated one-string storage set. `record-validator.single-value-blank.test.ts` pins that set to the table. It walks `FieldType.options` through `expandEmptyOperator`, and each untyped `null_only` type must sit in exactly one of {one-string, `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES`, `COMPUTED_VALUE_TYPES`}. The joined set (11) and the left-out set (9) are spelled as controls. The behavioural cases go through the door, so core's private set and the test's composition must agree; ablations L3 and L4 in the body show both directions red. This is not a hand list.
   - **Edges.** The `$empty` table is unchanged, `required` still refuses `''`, and a blank on insert still takes `defaultValue`. All three are pinned in the REST file on SQLite.
3. **Seed replay: right.** `isNoOpReplay` now compares `blankStorageForm(seedValue, comparands.blankAsNull.get(key))` with the stored value. Only the seed side is put in stored form, and the stored value is read as is. `blankAsNull` is a third `ReplayComparands` entry, built once per dataset by the same `blankAsNullColumns`.
   - **No blanket equality.** A column outside the map keeps the raw comparison, so on plain text a seed `''` against a stored `null` is still a change. `seed-blank-as-null-replay.integration.test.ts` pins that as its control: `totalUpdated: 1`, and the row then stores `''`.
   - **No false no-op.** The comparand is exactly "what the door would store". A seed `''` reaches `null` only where the door writes `null`, so it can equal only a stored `null`. A legacy stored `''` on these columns compares as `null` against `''`, which counts as changed, and that is true. The `'empty'` reach leaves whitespace as written. Credential masking runs before it on the raw value, unchanged.
   - **Pins and ablation.** All three arms are pinned (number, date, unique text, select: replay 0 updated, 4 skipped). The CI red from `375469fa` (`seed-blank-reference-real-driver` line 161) is fixed without touching its expectations. Ablation L5 turns both runtime files red.
4. **The read-shape move is stated: right.** A cleared optional select/radio/lookup/master_detail/user/tree/file-reference field now reads `null` and no longer matches `field = ''`. The #29277 changeset says this under "Read shape" and "Rows already stored", and so do the PR body's Acceptance notes and its 维护者速读 risk line. The REST `$empty` pin shows the table's own answers unchanged, with legacy `''` still a value.
5. **Forced test edits: right, nothing loosened.**
   - `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts`: four `VOCABULARY` rows deleted (`created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by` keyed on `record-validator.ts` at module level). The census fails on a row whose seam use is gone ("delete or re-key the row"). The names left the scanned objectql source for core's `ENGINE_LIFECYCLE_COLUMNS`, and their disposition said they read no row, so no reader leaves the census's sight. A forced deletion, not a loosening.
   - `seed-blank-reference-real-driver.integration.test.ts`: comment only, "it does not null one" corrected. `totalUpdated: 0` and `totalSkipped: 6` are unchanged.
   - The five round-1 edits reverse `''` to `null` on select/lookup as the ruling requires. That is stricter, not looser: `pick`/`ref` move into the covered set and the controls expect `null`. The text controls still expect `''`, and the "not typed" assertion is kept for every type moved.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: yes (widening)

- **Declaration lines.** The PR body and `.changeset/29277-single-value-blank-null.md` each carry the declaration key on exactly one line-initial line with the value `yes (widening)`. Each pairs it with a metadata-protocol line reading `none`. That matches the diff. Three core runtime exports are added and nothing is taken away: no door refuses anything it accepted, and a second unique clear goes from 409 to 201, the direction #29176 declared as no narrowing. No spec file and no metadata-protocol baseline is touched, so `none` is right.
- **Packages and levels: right.** objectql, core and metadata-protocol are each at `patch`, per seat ruling 6582252856 item 4. In the newer `Check Changeset` run, `check-changeset-no-major` reads the widening declaration and passes (patch, no baseline move). The older run passed too, reading the pre-amendment body. `check-adr-0087-registration` is green on both.
- **The #29176 correction: accurate.** The edited sentence now says "A text column no unique constraint covers keeps storing `''`", and in brackets that optional single-value select/lookup columns store a cleared `''` as `null`, unique or not, as a separate change in this release. That is true on this head. The bracket's "select / lookup" is shorthand for the full set the #29277 changeset lists, which is acceptable because both notes ship together. The rest of that note (the `$empty` line, defaults, rows already stored) is still true for text.
- **The red `Check Changeset`.** Both runs fail on `check-empty-changeset`, with the job log naming `.changeset/29176-optional-unique-blank-null.md` and the DELIBERATE CORRECTION remedy. That is the class confirmed in 6581612131 item 2, and the check is not a required context. No `skip-changeset` is used, and the sentence is not restored.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Round-1 open question, the four options (6577038603): answered** by maintainer ruling B on #29346 (6579813296). The head implements B, not A.
- **Round-2 open question, file references (6581571774): answered** by seat ruling 6581612131 item 1 (in, if stored as one string). On this head image/file/avatar/video/audio join through `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`. The REST tests pin POST, PATCH and a unique image cleared twice. The left-out types are named with the storage shape measured on SQLite.
- **Deviation, the corrected #29176 changeset: answered** (6581612131 item 2, and ② above).
- **Deviation, file surface wider than the claim: answered.** Ruling B binds every optional column, and claim amendment 6584075217 names the core, metadata-protocol and runtime files.
- **Deviation, lifecycle columns excluded and `owner_id` included: accepted.** It keeps the #29176 lifecycle exclusion, and ruling B's "every optional column" reads naturally as business columns. The `owner_id` claim holds on source: `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` lines 1516, 1521 and 1640 treat `== null` and `=== ''` as one.
- **Deviation, no assignee or reviewer on the PR:** process only, nothing contractual.
- **Seat ruling 6582252856, item by item: all four answered.**
  - **Item 1 (one predicate, a `ReplayComparands` entry):** done. The unique-text arm moved without pulling in a driver predicate, because `isUniqueDeclared` is the spec's.
  - **Item 2 (does main already churn):** the dev reports main replay churn of 4 of 4 rows at `071872b7` (#20308 number and date, and #29176 unique text). That number lives in the PR body, not in a card os-dev-report. All three arms are now pinned. **Accepted** as stated pre-existing churn that this PR closes.
  - **Item 3 (the stale comment):** corrected.
  - **Item 4 (the declaration):** amended on both carriers.
- **Not measured, carried as gaps, not blockers:** PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB (same knex path expected). No round-3 os-dev-report is on the card; the round-3 gate table and ablation L5 live only in the PR body.
- **Escalated to the seat, non-blocking:**
  - (a) The migrate card #29431 names select/radio/lookup/master_detail/user/tree only. Its column set should widen to the file-reference types this head adds, or legacy `''` stays on those columns.
  - (b) Ordering with #29244 (open): ruling B's execution step 3 says the door arm lands before or with it, and the seat sequences that.
  - (c) An edge read from source only, not measured: a seed `''` on an optional column that declares `defaultValue`. The insert stores the default, the stored-form comparand reads the replay as a change, and the update writes `null`. That is one rewrite, then stable. It is the door's insert-versus-update default asymmetry, which the typed arm already has on main, not a false no-op. Worth a probe card if the seat wants that answer pinned.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · PR #29464 · 2026-11-02T17:52Z

Head-sha: `22a779351bf40b62e478721343b78d8360b53b7d`

**维护者速读(席位终稿)**
- **改了什么**:可选的单值选项、引用、文件字段(`select`/`radio`/`lookup`/`master_detail`/`user`/`tree`/`image`/`file`/`avatar`/`video`/`audio`)被清空(送 `''`)时，写入口改存 `null`,唯一与否都一样。哪些类型算在内，由 `$empty` 规则表的 `null_only` 行加「存一个字符串」推出，有钉子测试绑到表上。三条「空白存 null」规则(#20308 类型列、#29176 唯一文本、本卡单值列)收到 `@objectstack/core` 一处，写入口和种子重放都读它。
- **为什么改**:维护者裁决 #29346 选 B(`6579813296`)。唯一字段上第二条清空的记录不再被 `409` 拒绝，清空的记录能被「为空」筛选到。种子里写 `''` 的行重放时不再每次开机都被重写(主干上三条规则都有这个空转，已实测)。
- **风险与回滚**:中低。读回形状有变：这些字段清空后读回 `null`,不再匹配 `field = ''`,changeset 已写明。已存的 `''` 不迁移，由 #29431 清理。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.ts`,`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`(`isNoOpReplay`)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/seed-blank-as-null-replay.integration.test.ts`,预期全绿，重放 0 条更新。
- **需要你做的**:无。席位按常设授权落地，合并即关 #29277。
- **席位意见**:可落，本 head CI 跑完全绿即入队。

### 核对六项
1. **形态**:draft → `main`,`Fixes #29277`。17 个文件，在认领及其修订 `6584075217` 的申报面内。被迫测试改动：清空的 select/lookup 期望由 `''` 改为 `null`(裁决要求，更严，不是放宽)、`federated-injected-column-readers` 删 4 行(生命周期列名搬到 core,普查自身提示删除)、一处过时注释更正。
2. **前提实测**:声明面契约复审 PASS(本 PR 上 `## Contract review` 记录,TIER_DEFAULT,独立会话)。复审逐条核对：两条旧规则覆盖的列与主干一致，新规则按裁决加入;重放只把种子一侧换成存储形态，纯文本列 `''` 对 `null` 仍算变更，不会把真变更误判为无变更。
3. **门禁**:dev 第三轮(head `22a77935`):core 3021、metadata-protocol 22161、objectql 10320、runtime 9678、rest 7329 全绿，各 typecheck exit 0;消融 L5(关掉比较项)两条 runtime 钉子转红，复原哈希一致;dispatch-gates 63/63,0 未测;`pnpm lint` 0。入队前席位读本 head 全部 check-run。
4. **接受的偏差**:生命周期列不纳入、`owner_id` 纳入(复审对源码核过，鉴权中间件把 `null` 与 `''` 同等看待)。`Check Changeset` 红(`check-empty-changeset`)= 更正 #29176 待发 changeset 的 DELIBERATE CORRECTION,已在 `6581612131` 确认，不是必需检查。第三轮读数写在 PR 正文，没有另贴 os-dev-report,接受。
5. **开放问题裁定**:文件类型按存储形态并入(`6581612131`);重放比较按存储形态(`6582252856`),四项均已落实。复审提的后续:#29431 的列范围已补到 11 种类型(本卡注记);#29244(席 1)在本 PR 合并后落地;带 `defaultValue` 的列种子写 `''` 会多重写一次后稳定，属插入/更新默认值的既有不对称，不在本卡范围。
6. **落地条款**:`Clause-②: yes (widening)`(core 新增三个导出),`Metadata-protocol: none`,PR 正文与 changeset 都有。semver:`@objectstack/objectql`、`@objectstack/core`、`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 均 `patch`。`check-governed-merges --pr 29464`:NOT governed。落地授权，维护者原话:「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」(2026-10-25T11:35Z)。

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [41498966913](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/41498966913) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test Core (2/8)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/41498966913/job/125462698081)** — 失败步骤: Run this shard's tests

  ```
  @objectstack/spec:test:  FAIL   local  scripts/dropped-refinements.test.ts > the committed ledger > names at least one site per entry, and its header totals match its body
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/spec:test: AssertionError: expected 993 to be 998 // Object.is equality
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
